title: Easy Movie Tickets with Fandango
description: http://www.madhattermom.com  A walkthrough of just how easy it is to order movie tickets through Fandango.com!

asr.full_text: Hi everybody, it's Tina from MadHatterMom.com. I'm here today to show you how easy it is to purchase your movie tickets on Fandango.com. The family and I are going to be going to see Poppers Penguins this weekend and I thought,. You know what, let's just make it easy and buy our tickets in advance. So let's head to Fandango right now and check it out. All right, so as you can see, we're at the Fandango site. I've already found our movie theater that we're going to be going to. So we are going to find the movie that we want. Here's Popper's Penguins right here. Let's see. And then we're going to come over here and find the show that we want to go to. You know what we actually have a t-ball game tomorrow so we're going to go ahead and pick. The 445 show we're going to click on that so it says that we have about seven minutes to complete. Our transaction up here at the top it's counting down and they accept paypal which i think is. Awesome so we're going to do two adult tickets one for myself and one for my husband two child tickets. And that's about it. We're going to go ahead and continue to our checkout. And then we come down here and have our payment options. I'm going to choose PayPal because. It's just easier. Go ahead and enter in my email address in order to get confirmation. I'm going to continue to PayPal. Enter in my password and again this is going to be just like any other PayPal transaction that. You have it's just going to all go through Fandango so I'm going to click continue. And then here is my last chance i'm going to confirm my tickets. 41 kind of spendy but you know what it'll be a fun thing that we can do to celebrate. Father's day this weekend and it's something that we don't do very often so. I'll go ahead and complete our purchase. And we're done it gives us our confirmation number also gives us the option to print our. Tickets. It tells us that it's going to print four pages, just so we know, and that's it. So I want to show you what it looks like whenever you go to print your tickets. It's going to give. You a ticket just like this, and you actually have the option of just skipping the box office. Altogether. You can go directly to the ticket podium and have your print at home ticket scanned,. And then you're free to go inside and enjoy the show. So it saves you time,. And you don't have to worry about getting there and having the show sold out and not being able. To get in. So there you go.
